evidence.result: The existing owner maintains committed settings, account caches, and reconstruction state. The settings comparison baseline is derived from that account state rather than maintained as a separate dirty inventory.
The database retains ownership of transactional writes and exact damaged-row retention. Domain rows extend the existing commit and retention mechanisms.
The submitted-settings cache has a concrete performance purpose and remains under the session owner. Existing pending changes retain retry responsibility; the cache does not claim durability.

Callers express domain changes without knowing table names, migration markers, or transaction order. Normal saves, migration, repair, and reconstruction converge on existing owner operations. No concrete ownership leak or unjustified change amplification was found.
